name: Honorary Picks
summary: In Ironforge, Honorary Picks are prepared for Brock Stoneseeker’s mining apprentices in Thelsamar. Gryphons carry them to Loch Modan, where the ceremonial tools mark students ready to work its ore veins.

sections.title: Tools for the Next Generation
sections.body: Mining keeps the great forges burning and supplies dwarves with iron and stone. In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker teaches young apprentices to mine. Honorary Picks from Ironforge recognize students ready to work the open ore deposits across Loch Modan.

sections.title: Testing the Gryphon Lines
sections.body: The picks travel through the Alliance gryphon network, linking Ironforge with its outlying settlements. Gryth Thurden receives the shipment at Ironforge’s Great Forge and sends it over the mountains to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

faq.q: What are the Honorary Picks used for?
faq.answer: Brock Stoneseeker’s mining students in Loch Modan receive the Honorary Picks. The ceremonial tools are ready for apprentices to use on ore veins across the region.

faq.q: Who sends the picks, and who receives them?
faq.answer: The picks are prepared in Ironforge and brought to Gryth Thurden at the city’s gryphon roost. They fly east to Thelsamar, where mining instructor Brock Stoneseeker receives them.

faq.q: Why do the picks need to be delivered by gryphon?
faq.answer: Gryphons carry the picks quickly between Ironforge and Loch Modan, and the route teaches travelers to use the Alliance’s established flight paths. They could also be carried on foot through the North Gate Pass.

faq.q: Are the Honorary Picks actual weapons or tools you can equip?
faq.answer: No. The courier carries the picks as cargo for Brock Stoneseeker’s mining students, who are eager to use them on Loch Modan’s ore deposits.

angles.text: As a miner, you know the value of a solid pick. An honorary tool marks a novice’s passage into the profession.
As a dwarf, you know the kinship and craft behind presenting tools forged in Ironforge to apprentices working in the provinces.
